label: preparing
what: A coordinated, undisclosed service acknowledgement/event for the mayor in the great hall, with hospitality/community supper preparations and voluntary bread/grain contributions; the record does not establish exactly what is being prepared or whether the supper is part of the acknowledgement. The mayor has been told about a lighting inspection, but the overheard coordination and mention of a service acknowledgement point to an additional concealed element. The secretary and others knowingly help with logistics/escort; the exact role of baker and freight in the event remains uncertain, though they are associated with the bakery gathering and donation/food activity. The mayor is not shown to have been told the service acknowledgement was planned.
